en.headline: Three Hong Kong riders in Asian Games jumping final
en.dek: RTHK said the Nagoya Games close on Sunday night, with the last two golds still to be decided in show jumping.
body: The Asian Games in Nagoya close on Sunday, and Hong Kong's remaining competitive day is in the equestrian arena. RTHK reported early on Sunday that the closing ceremony will be held on Sunday evening at the Mizuho Park athletics stadium, and that show jumping will produce the final two gold medals of the Games.

Three Hong Kong riders qualified for Sunday morning's individual finals, the Hong Kong Commercial Daily reported from Saturday's rounds at the Japan Racing Association's equestrian park. In the new A group, for fences of 1.45 to 1.50 metres, Lai Ching-man on Kalina's Way completed the round on zero faults and was provisionally fourth. Lai Ka-yi, on the Jockey Club-sponsored horse SG S Air Pilot, had 12 faults and was provisionally 19th. The paper said the top 20 advance, with at most two riders from each country or region.

In the B group, where fences rise to 1.55 metres, Lam Lap-sun on Lopez One had 11 faults and was provisionally 11th among 16 riders, the paper said. It noted that Lam and Lai Ching-man won team bronze in show jumping at the 2010 Guangzhou Games, and that the Hong Kong riders train under an elite programme run by the Hong Kong Equestrian Federation and the Hong Kong Jockey Club.

On the tables, RTHK said Hong Kong was ninth with 11 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze, while the national team led both the gold and overall medal counts. The Olympic Council of Asia is also due to name the men's and women's most valuable athletes on Sunday night, with a prize of US$25,000 each.

zh.headline: 亞運今晚閉幕 三名港隊騎手出戰場地障礙決賽
zh.dek: 港台報道，名古屋亞運周日晚上閉幕，最後兩面金牌留待馬術場地障礙賽產生。
body: 名古屋亞運周日閉幕，港隊餘下的出賽日在馬術場。香港電台周日凌晨報道，閉幕禮周日晚上在瑞穗公園田徑場舉行，場地障礙賽將產生今屆最後兩面金牌。
香港商報報道，三名港隊騎手已晉身周日早上的個人賽決賽。新賽制下，A組欄高1.45至1.50米，賴楨敏策騎Kalina's Way，周六以0罰分暫列第4；黎嘉怡策騎馬會贊助馬匹SG S Air Pilot，以12罰分暫列第19。該報指A組頭20名可入決賽，每個國家或地區最多兩人。
B組欄高最高1.55米，林立信策騎Lopez One，以11罰分在16人中暫列第11，商報說。該報又指，林立信與賴楨敏曾在2010年廣州亞運奪得場地障礙團體銅牌，港隊騎手在中國香港馬術總會與香港賽馬會合辦的精英計劃下受訓。
獎牌榜方面，港台稱中國香港暫以11金19銀24銅排第9，國家隊在金牌榜及獎牌榜均領先。亞奧理事會亦將在周日晚上公布男女最有價值運動員，各獲2萬5千美元獎金。
